events.title: Carlyle Shares Plunge as Q1 Earnings Miss Estimates, AUM Rises Y/Y
events.body: CG shares sink after Q1 earnings miss estimates as realized performance revenues plunge despite a y/y rise in the total AUM.

events.title: KKR Shares Slip as Weak ANI Outlook Overshadows Q1 Earnings Beat
events.body: KKR tops Q1 earnings estimates as AUM and fee income surge, but shares slip after management lowers visibility on reaching $7-per-share ANI.

events.title: KKR & Co. Shares Gain as Q1 Earnings Beat Estimates, AUM Rises Y/Y
events.body: KKR shares rise after Q1 earnings beat estimates, fueled by strong AUM growth and higher fees, though rising expenses temper overall gains.
